notes: أبى رحمه الله قال: the compiler's father, named by relation only
بإسناد يرفعه is a gap: the chain up to Mansur is elided (rule 8), so it is unnamed, in its place
كنت عند أبي عبد الله ... فقال: the Imam is named in the words after the chain and his speech is the saying, so imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the place («عند») does not make him a scene-only figure
